## IssueNewToken

```go
func (s *TokenizationService) IssueNewToken(ctx context.Context, body *CreateTokenRequestDto, opts ...RequestOption) (*TokenLinkDto, error)
```

`POST /tokenization/tokens` · rate-limit category: `write`

**Issue a new token**

Facilitates the creation of a new token, supporting both EVM-based and Stellar/Ripple platforms. For EVM, it deploys the corresponding contract template to the blockchain and links the token to the workspace. For Stellar/Ripple, it links a newly created token directly to the workspace without deploying a contract. Returns the token link with status "PENDING" until the token is deployed or "SUCCESS" if no deployment is needed.
Endpoint Permission: Owner, Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, and Editor.

**Request body:** [`*CreateTokenRequestDto`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#CreateTokenRequestDto)

**Returns:** [`*TokenLinkDto`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#TokenLinkDto)

```go
func (s *TokenizationService) GetTokenTotalSupply(ctx context.Context, id string, params *GetTokenTotalSupplyParams, opts ...RequestOption) (*TotalSupplyPagedResponse, error)
```

`GET /tokenization/tokens/{id}/total_supply` · rate-limit category: `query`

**Get historical total supply for a token**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| `params.EndDate` | query | `string` |  | End date of the time range in ISO 8601 format |
| `params.Interval` | query | [`GetTokenTotalSupplyInterval`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#GetTokenTotalSupplyInterval) |  | Time interval for grouping data |
| `params.PageCursor` | query | `string` |  | Page cursor to get the next page |
| `params.PageSize` | query | `int64` |  | Number of items per page (max 100), requesting more than 100 will return 100 items |
| `params.SortBy` | query | [`GetTokenTotalSupplySortBy`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#GetTokenTotalSupplySortBy) |  | Sorting field (enum). Sorting only supported by 'blockTimestamp' |
| `params.Order` | query | [`GetTokenTotalSupplyOrder`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#GetTokenTotalSupplyOrder) |  | ASC / DESC ordering (default DESC) |
